convergence: Closed forms; the model fit is a linear least-squares problem solved exactly.
domain: Every glass: nd and Vd, up to 22 tabulated lines, and three wavelengths across its fit. Model glass: coefficients, error over three ranges, five wavelengths at four (nd, Vd) pairs.
outside_scope: No temperature dependence, no melt-to-melt tolerance, no moulding shift of index (moulded aspheres differ from the annealed catalogue glass by about 1e-3). The model glass is a normal-line estimate: its error is stated, largest for dense flints near their ultraviolet edge.
provenance: Fits transcribed from the dataset records; tabulated indices read from the manufacturers' data sheets; the model glass's coefficients and error statistics computed in this module.
reference: The catalogues' printed nd and Vd and the data sheets' tabulated indices; the model glass refitted here by least squares ([code](../validation/reference/glass_catalogue.py))
scope: 84 catalogue glasses (SCHOTT, OHARA, CDGM, HOYA) inside each fit's range, at the catalogue temperature (20 C, OHARA 25 C), indices relative to air; the model glass over 365-1014 nm.
title: Glass catalogue of step L1 and the model glass
tolerance_rationale: 1e-5 for indices printed to five decimals and for nd; 0.01 for Vd printed to two decimals; 1e-9 for transcription; 1e-6 for refitted coefficients; 5 % relative for error statistics stated to two significant figures.
